description_en: Updates multiple accelerated domain names at a time
description_zh: 调用BatchUpdateCdnDomain批量更新加速域名基本信息
name: BatchUpdateCdnDomain

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names. You can specify one or more accelerated domain names. Separate domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The information about the addresses of origin servers.

Do not set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time. If you set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time, TopLevelDomain does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
回源地址列表。

不支持同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，如果您同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，TopLevelDomain将不生效
parameters.name: sources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The root domain.

Do not set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time. If you set Sources and TopLevelDomain at the same time, TopLevelDomain does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
顶级接入域。

不支持同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，如果您同时传入Sources和TopLevelDomain参数，TopLevelDomain将不生效
parameters.name: top_level_domain
